title: हिंदू कोड बिल
palette: cold institutional palette, pale green walls, fluorescent flatness, empty corridors

scenes.n: 26 जनवरी 1950। भारत गणराज्य बन चुका था। संविधान लागू हो चुका था।
beats: A wide ceremonial avenue in Delhi on a cold January morning, thin winter light, crowds along the verges seen from far above, wide shot
A cold empty government hall on republic morning, flags without emblems along the walls, pale light, wide shot

scenes.n: डॉ. आंबेडकर अब स्वतंत्र भारत के कानून मंत्री थे।
scenes.p: A law ministry office with pale green walls, a heavy desk and a wall of legal volumes, flat institutional light, nobody at the desk, wide shot

scenes.n: लेकिन उनके सामने एक और बड़ा सवाल था। क्या कानून सिर्फ राज्य को बदलेगा? या समाज के भीतर परिवार और सामाजिक संबंधों को भी?
beats: A courtroom and a domestic doorway seen in the same frame through an open corridor, one formal and one ordinary, flat daylight, wide shot
A formal courtroom door and a plain household door side by side in a pale corridor, flat light, medium shot
A law volume and a household account book set together on a cold desk, flat light, close shot

scenes.n: इसी संदर्भ में Hindu Code Bill आया।
scenes.p: A thick unbound bill of draft legislation tied with tape on a desk, cold window light, close shot

scenes.n: डॉ. आंबेडकर महिलाओं के कानूनी अधिकारों को लेकर गंभीर थे।
beats: A woman's hands resting on a closed ledger on a table, a plain sari sleeve, no face in frame, cold even light, close shot
A woman standing at a barred office window seen from behind, cold light on her shoulders, medium shot

scenes.p: Looking straight down at four objects on a dark table — a marriage garland, a broken thread, a property deed and a family register, overhead shot

scenes.n: इन मुद्दों पर हिंदू व्यक्तिगत कानून में सुधार की आवश्यकता पर बहस चल रही थी।
beats: A committee room mid-debate, papers in the air, empty chairs pushed back at odd angles, pale institutional light, wide shot
A stack of amendment papers scattered across a committee table, chairs askew, pale light, overhead shot

scenes.n: डॉ. आंबेडकर चाहते थे कि कानून महिलाओं को अधिक अधिकार दे।
beats: A woman seen from behind at the threshold of a courtroom doorway, light falling on her shoulders, the room beyond in shadow, medium shot
A pair of scales on a courtroom bench weighted unequally between two figures, cold light, medium shot

scenes.n: लेकिन विधेयक को लेकर राजनीतिक विरोध और लंबी बहसें हुईं। प्रक्रिया धीमी पड़ती गई।
beats: A parliamentary chamber with many empty seats and a few members scattered across them, an unread bill on every desk, cold flat light, wide shot
A wall clock in a near-empty chamber reading late, an unread bill on each desk, cold light, wide shot

scenes.n: और अंततः... 27 अक्टूबर 1951 को डॉ. आंबेडकर ने कानून मंत्री के पद से इस्तीफा दे दिया।
beats: A fountain pen laid down across a typed letter of resignation on a bare desk, cold window light, a hand withdrawing, close shot
An empty minister's chair pushed back from a bare desk, a single sheet left on it, cold window light, medium shot

scenes.n: उनके इस्तीफे के पीछे कई राजनीतिक और नीतिगत असहमति थीं, लेकिन Hindu Code Bill की धीमी प्रगति इस प्रकरण का महत्वपूर्ण हिस्सा थी।
beats: An office being emptied, books packed into wooden crates, bare shelves behind, flat afternoon light, wide shot
Bare bookshelves with pale rectangles where volumes once stood, cold light, medium shot
A stack of the unpassed bill left tied on an emptied desk, cold light, close shot

scenes.n: यह घटना महत्वपूर्ण थी। क्योंकि इससे पता चलता है कि संविधान बनने के बाद भी डॉ. आंबेडकर की राजनीति का केंद्र सिर्फ संविधान नहीं था।
beats: A long empty ministry corridor with identical closed doors receding, one door standing open at the far end, institutional light, wide shot
A single open door at the end of a corridor with grey daylight beyond, cold flat light, wide shot
A blank office door-plate holder with the card removed, pale green wall, close shot

scenes.n: वह समाज के भीतर कानूनी बराबरी को भी उतना ही महत्वपूर्ण मानते थे। और शायद यही वजह है कि उनके लिए सामाजिक न्याय एक पूरा राजनीतिक कार्यक्रम था।
beats: A courtroom bench and a household threshold shown as two doorways side by side in a plain wall, even light, wide shot
A balance scale set exactly level on a cold table between a law book and a family register, close shot

scenes.n: लेकिन अब उनकी राजनीति एक और मोड़ लेने वाली थी। उन्हें लगने लगा था कि राजनीतिक रास्ते सीमित हैं।
beats: A road running out of a city into open country at dusk, the buildings ending abruptly, a single figure walking away seen from behind, wide shot
A sign-less road ending at open fields, a figure standing at the edge seen from behind, dusk, wide shot

scenes.n: और उनके सामने धर्म का प्रश्न और अधिक स्पष्ट होता जा रहा था।
beats: A small clay lamp being lit by unseen hands in a dark room, the flame taking hold, everything else black, close shot
A single steady flame held in cupped hands emerging from darkness, close shot
